title: I-Scout Enezimpaphe
intro: Ngaphakathi kombuso obuswa yilowo onikwe ubukhosi phezu kwemimoya, izidalwa ezingabonakali, kanye nezidalwa zezulu, ilungu elilodwa elincane nelisheshayo lanyamalala ezikhundleni - labuya nezambulo ezazizokwakha kabusha isiphetho sesizwe esikude. Lo mnikezeli onolwazi onamehlo abukhali waletha iqiniso ekukhanyeni lapho ukungazi kwaqala khona. Ngingubani?
clues: Ngakhonza enkantolo lapho abantu, izidalwa ezingabonakali, nezidalwa zezulu zazisabela kumbusi oyedwa ohlakaniphile owayelawula imimoya.
Bengingekho emsebenzini wami isikhashana, futhi intukuthelo yombusi yathenjiswa uma nginganikezi isizathu esanele.
Ngiyisidalwa esincane esindizayo, esaziwa ngokubona okubukhali, futhi uhlobo lwami lwahlonishwa ngokuqanjwa ngamagama ngqo emakhasini esambulo.
Lapho ngibuya, ngilethe izindaba zezwe elikude lapho abantu babekhothamela khona ilanga, bengaboni kuLowo owadala amazulu nomhlaba.
Ngithole owesifazane ebusa umbuso omkhulu, ehlezi esihlalweni sobukhosi esihle kakhulu, engakaze alazi iqiniso ngaphambili.
Nginguyena owathola umbuso waseSaba futhi waphatha incwadi yesimemo esivela kumprofethi-inkosi eyanikwa ukubusa phezu komoya.
arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verse: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (27:27)
